_comment: Tasks for building / flashing / monitoring the ravine.1une.cc ESP32-S3 firmware. All tasks go through tools/build.sh, which sources ESP-IDF v6.1's export.sh in a subshell and forwards args to idf.py. The same task definitions are exposed in CLion via tools/clion-setup.md Method B.

tasks.label: Build firmware
tasks.detail: idf.py build (incremental). Output: build/esp32_po33_ko.bin (~995 KB / 68% of 3 MB factory partition).

tasks.label: Clean build
tasks.detail: Wipe build/ and rebuild from scratch. Use when sdkconfig.defaults changes or after migrating to a new IDF major version.

tasks.label: Menuconfig
tasks.detail: TUI to edit sdkconfig values. Save the new sdkconfig (in build/ or project root) into sdkconfig.defaults if you want the change to stick across fullclean.

tasks.label: Set ESP32-S3 fuses (one-time)
tasks.detail: One-time per-board fuse burn (e.g. 16 MB flash, 80 MHz octal). NOT for everyday development; you only do this when provisioning a new board.

tasks.label: Flash firmware
tasks.detail: Build + write to the connected ESP32-S3. You will be prompted for the serial port (default /dev/ttyUSB0 on Linux, /dev/cu.usbserial-* on macOS, COM7 on Windows).

tasks.label: Monitor serial output
tasks.detail: Open the serial monitor. Ctrl-] to exit.

tasks.label: Build + flash + monitor
tasks.detail: Convenience pipeline. Run all three in order.

tasks.label: Firmware size report
tasks.detail: Print a per-symbol size summary. Useful for keeping the firmware below the 3 MB factory partition limit.

tasks.label: Install ESP-IDF v6.1 (EIM)
tasks.command: [ -d "$HOME/.espressif/v6.1/esp-idf" ] && echo "IDF v6.1 already installed at $HOME/.espressif/v6.1/esp-idf" || (echo "Run the EIM installer: https://dl.espressif.com/dl/esp-idf/" && echo "Pick v6.1 + ESP32-S3 target. This task is a placeholder; it does not actually invoke the installer." && exit 1)
tasks.detail: Stub task. The real installer is interactive; run it from a terminal once per machine. See tools/clion-setup.md for the script-based equivalent.
